keywords: Elementary functions 2.Limits of functions 3.Differential coefficients and derivatives 4.Indefinite integral 5.Definite integral
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn about the graphs of functions. (2) Learn about the limits of functions. (3) Learn about the differential coefficients and derivatives. (4) Learn about the indefinite integrals of functions. (5) Learn about the definite integrals of functions.
advice: This is a basic course of calculus. We will cover the following materials. 1. Functions and Their Graphs 2. Limits of Functions 3 Differential Coefficients and Derivatives 4. Riemann Integrals and Fundamental Theorem of Calculus 5. Indefinite and Definite Integrations Classes include exercises and quizzes, and a final examination at the end of the semester. Daily preparation and review are important. Students are required to solve designated tasks. Students should study reports and research topics in a planned manner, and strictly avoid plagiarism. Students should actively use the teachers' office hours and the Math. and Science Education Research Center.
books: Textbooks: Mathematics for Information Science A (Calculus) [kanazawa Institute of Technology] Reference books:None Reserved books:None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics (Formula calculation, exponential/ logarithmic/trigonometric functions, etc.) Basic Excel skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the general shape and characteristics of graphs of elementary functions.
Be able to find the derivatives of basic functions.
Be able to find the indefinite integrals of basic functions.
Be able to evaluate the definite integrals of basic functions.
Understand the meanings of fundamental english words for mathematics.
Try to understand the contents, and be able to complete the tasks within the deadlines.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Be able to explain the general shape and characteristics of graphs of elementary functions. (2) Understand the concept of differentiation and be able to calculate the derivatives of various functions. (3) Be able to find indefinite integrals of various functions. (4) Be able to evaluate definite integral of various functions. (5) Understand the basic English expressions of mathematical terms and express themselves. (6) Attend classes, try to understand the contents of classes, complete submitted tasks, and challenge development issues.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the general shapes and characteristics of graphs of elementary functions. (2) Understand the definition of derivative and be able to find derivatives of basic functions. (3) Be able to find indefinite integrals of basic functions. (4) Be able to evaluate definite integrals of elementary functions. (5) Understand the basic English expressions of mathematical terms. (6) Attend classes, try to understand the contents of classes, and complete submitted tasks.
